observation_summary: The code in HelpFormatter.findWrapPos attempts to scan for whitespace beyond the end of the string using an incorrect loop condition (pos <= text.length()), leading to a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. The logic for finding a wrap position is procedurally flawed when no whitespace is present.
hypothesis: The method findWrapPos in HelpFormatter contains an incorrect loop condition (pos <= text.length()) that attempts to access characters beyond the string's bounds when no whitespace is found within the specified width. This causes a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Furthermore, the logic intended to 'chop' the text at startPos + width is flawed because it incorrectly attempts to scan forward for whitespace even when the string is shorter than the requested width or when no whitespace exists, leading to both crashes and incorrect wrap positions.
prediction: The loop at lines 937-941 is unnecessary for the intended behavior of 'chopping' at startPos + width when no whitespace is found.
